notes.subject: mountains of prey
notes.rationale: מהררי טרף: 'mountains of prey' (i.e. hunter's heights) vs 'mountains full of game' vs JPS 'coming down from' — the image is debated.

notes.subject: נאור
notes.rationale: Niphal participle of אור 'light' — 'you are made luminous'; the light-root echoes v5's brightness of the divine presence.

notes.subject: to Yawe
notes.rationale: Direct second-person address to God, continuing from v4.

translation: I ye yeelen-ɲagami, i ka girikan ka bon baganminɛ kuluma la.
